_comment: Fabled mesh pipeline config. Tri budgets are triangles AFTER triangulation (what Unreal counts).
_source_up_axis_note: Used when fabled_profile.up_axis is absent. Y = source is Y-up (rotated to Z-up on import); Z = already Z-up.
_source_units_note: Smithsonian lists the download as 'scale in mm', but the mesh measures 20.91 x 8.11 x 11.09 units (H x W x D). Catalogue dims for NPG.75.16 with base are 50.5 x 21.9 x 26.7 cm. mm would give a 2.1 cm bust and cm a 21 cm one; inches give 53.1 x 20.6 x 28.2 cm (within ~6% of the catalogue), so the file is treated as inches (0.0254 m/unit). This is an inference from measurements, not a documented unit.
_reference_dims_note: Catalogue H x W x D with base, from https://npg.si.edu/object/npg_NPG.75.16
_bake_source_note: 0 = bake from the full-resolution sculpt. Set e.g. 2000000 to pre-decimate the bake source if RAM is tight.

retopo._quadriflow_note: QuadriFlow is run on a copy scaled so its largest dimension equals each solve height in turn (Blender's pre-check rejects small real-world-sized meshes); first height that QuadriFlow accepts wins.

ao._note: AO is baked from the high-poly onto LOD0 into ORM.R; roughness (G) and metallic (B) are constants, not measured.

_asset_name_note: null = derived from the input file stem (sanitised for Unreal names). Override with --asset-name or by setting this key.
